s: This project builds a powerful, single-tenant web app using HTMX and FastHTML, leveraging a log-based system for state management to achieve resilient, progressive parameter collection akin to desktop apps, while embracing 'anti-patterns' for simplified, deterministic deployments via Nix Flakes.
sub: Log-based state management for resilient parameter queues.
HTMX and FastHTML for SPA-like UX with progressive form filling.
Single-tenant architecture as an 'anti-pattern' for simplified, deterministic deployments.
Nix Flakes and Determinate Systems for reproducible macOS installations and app deployment.
